item.title: Security Advisory: Unauthorized Access via Credential Stuffing [resolved]
item.description:
Final Update: We have concluded our investigation into the reports of unauthorized account access. Our team has worked directly with the small number of affected customers to secure their accounts and remediate any unauthorized changes.
Monitoring & Conclusion: We have seen no further evidence of unauthorized activity related to this incident. Our systems remain secure, and we continue to monitor for suspicious login patterns.
Ongoing Security Best Practices: While this incident is resolved, credential stuffing remains a common web-wide threat. To keep your account secure, we strongly recommend:
• Enabling MFA on all Pantheon user accounts. • Using unique passwords managed via a password manager. • Rotating secrets/keys if you suspect your local environment has been compromised.
